findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: AGENTS.md:573 and packages/main/src/core/prompt-registry.ts:59 instruct Agents to record through or trigger an authoritative Dynamic Finding applicability/history path as if it were available now. findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/prompt-registry-smoke.ts:124-210 semantic-equivalence bypass (high): the 13 committed inverse mutations each bite, but each is paired to a narrow surface regex rather than the prohibited semantic class. A read-only probe against the exact committed validator accepted 13/13 equivalent paraphrases while `--review-finding-triage-only` still passed, including `A reviewer is allowed to invoke gap_log`, inverted dismissal/out_of_scope wording, `Scope follows severity`, superseded-envelope reviewRunId `stays valid`, passive reviewer repair/story_create/scope expansion, applicability-driven severity lowering, plural `Routed findings are resolved`, evidence-free routing without a high/critical noun, `This prompt determines whether the REVIEW gate blocks`, disjoint-files wording, and canonical-duplicate wording with reversed token order. Thus the test does not prove the required prohibitions and a contract containing equivalent contradictory instructions can still be made green by refreshing the five approved digests. Replace phrase-shape matching with a bounded semantic contract representation or add robust inverse/paraphrase mutation coverage that fails on these equivalent forms.
